/etc/systemd/system/box-network-priority.content:
[Unit]
Description=BOX preferred egress traffic queue
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target firewalld.service
Before=apache2.service box-proxy.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/box-network-priority apply
ExecReload=/usr/local/sbin/box-network-priority apply
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/box-network-priority remove
TimeoutStartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=30
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK AF_INET AF_INET6

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

/etc/systemd/system/whatsapp-resource-pr.content:
[Unit]
Description=WhatsApp priority using BOX egress classes and proportional I/O
Requires=box-network-priority.service
After=box-network-priority.service network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/openai-codex/projects/whatsapp-personal/scripts/resource_priority.py apply --apply
ExecReload=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/openai-codex/projects/whatsapp-personal/scripts/resource_priority.py apply --apply
TimeoutStartSec=30
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/sys/fs/cgroup/io.cost.qos /run/lock
ProtectKernelModules=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK AF_INET AF_INET6

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
